statement: A failed push gate, by any path, keeps the evidence that names its failure. The acceptance runner buffers every command's output into a captured artifact inside the gate checkout (spawnSync, piped), so the change proof's per-file results never reach the terminal, and gateExactSha (scripts/checks/push-gate-corpus-worktree.js, added by d9819d43e) removes that checkout on every exit; the publisher already keeps a failed gate's receipt and first failing artifact (retainGateDiagnostics, fc6db88ee, after the 2026-08-19 incident) and the direct-push gate regressed that class. Now: gateExactSha keeps the same diagnostics, through the publisher's one retainGateDiagnostics, on every non-zero return (a failed run, a replaced injection link, a dirtied checkout) before the checkout is removed, and prints where; the run summary names the failing test files of the first failing command from its captured artifact, read line by line through the bounded reader (the runner's file-level verdict lines only, the last verdict deciding, a retried-once pass green, lab-relayed lines read), bounded with an explicit withheld count and saying 'summary line absent - list may be incomplete' instead of a count when no runner summary line was captured; the verdict stays the command's status; and the pre-push banner says what actually happens.

constraints.statement: Existing files change; no file is added under scripts/ (the receipt is produced by the existing harness runtime from a declaration in this quest's evidence directory) and no workflow is added; ratchet baselines only tighten.
The publisher's retainGateDiagnostics is exported and reused by gateExactSha; there is no second implementation.
The failing-file list is diagnosis only: the gate's and the command's verdict remain their exit status, never the parsed lines.

The captured artifact is never parsed whole or held in memory: it is read through the existing bounded reader; the printed list is bounded and counts what it withheld, and an absent summary line is reported as incomplete, not counted.
The manifest runner is not made async or streaming; its per-manifest contract is unchanged except the captured artifact's line-per-element stream encoding.
